thumbnail: Both A-400.png and B-400.png share the exact same clean two-column layout on a cream background: bold dark-green title 'Editing Fuel Well' at top-left, three legible left-column instruction blocks ('Change the headline', 'Replace the leaf', 'Export the poster'), and a square 'FUEL WELL. LIVE WELL.' green-leaf poster preview on the right whose smallest captions soften at 400px while the main instructions stay readable. Even in the thumbnails, the only visible difference is in the third left-column block: A prints 'resvg creates SVG. Satori turns it into PNG.' while B prints 'Satori creates SVG. resvg turns it into PNG.'
